We report results and statistical significance using scripts released with the WMT19 shared task. Segment-level performance is reported as the Kendall's τ variant used in the shared task, and system-level performance is reported as Pearson correlation with the mean of the human judgments.
guideline: Human judgments were collected as part of the WMT19 shared task, using reference-based or source-based evaluation depending on the language pair.
